{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders — only 'completed' should be in the population
population = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check final population
print(f"Final population size: {len(population)}")
print(f"Channel distribution in population: {population['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")
print(f"Conversion rate by channel:")
print(population.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().round(4))"}
